t: This round bulkhead wall light is a durable outdoor lighting fixture designed to illuminate exterior spaces reliably. Ideal for trade professionals and DIYers installing entrance lighting on domestic properties, this mains-powered unit features a robust black plastic body and a clear glass diffuser, ensuring long-lasting performance. This wall-mounted fitting requires a single E27 GLS bulb to deliver clear, bright illumination. Fixings are supplied for a straightforward installation process.
b: Requires 1 x E27 GLS Light Bulb
